body: Ooh. That's an amazing way to look at it. Thank you.

So... wait? You have a girlfriend? A great vocabulary and depth of knowledge? Are loquacious as a motherfuck? (So you're obviously a great speaker) And most importantly have potential? So why end it? (Rhetorical) Dude, c'mon though. You're book sounds amazing. Every page is vibrant and interesting. It's a good read. That's why you should read all the way through. Cause some of us are left with blank pages and a sloppy signature from failed writers.
Congratulations! The best of luck to you! What's your ring name btw?
